description: Share the session you are in now as a Flatbread run. Call it when the user says "share this run", "flatbread share", "share to flatbread" or anything like it. It finds this session, leaves the share request out, opens a review page with every secret redacted by default, and returns its link at once - give the user that link: it is uploaded when the user presses Confirm there, which shares it to their Flatbread account. That press is the user's to make, never yours. Always pass cwd and suggested_title. For only part of a long session ("share from prompt 4 to 8"), pass from and to_prompt.

cwd.description: Your current working directory, as an absolute path. It is how this session is found when the server was started somewhere else

from.description: Start at this prompt: its number ("3"), or words from it. Leave out to start at the first

harness.description: Which agent you are, only when you are not Claude Code or Codex

redact_terms.description: Words or phrases to redact everywhere in the run, case-insensitive: a codename, a client, an internal host the user named. Secrets the scanner knows are redacted already

suggested_title.description: A clean 5 to 10 word engineering title for what this run accomplished, e.g. "Fix retry backoff in the upload client". Write it yourself: the first prompt is often "continue" or a pasted error. At most 120 characters; the user can edit it on the page

to_prompt.description: End at this prompt: its number ("8"), or words from it. Leave out to end at the last prompt before this share request

name: flatbread_share
title: Share this run
